_comment: Values read by the vault tools and skills. Change these instead of editing scripts. template: true only in the Folio template itself (folio.py new drops it). project: the project's name. projects: the code repos this vault logs (relative to the vault); folio.py link links the skills into them for the agents in agents. features: set by folio.py (new / add / remove). folio: path to the Folio template, used by folio.py add. chat_language: the language agents chat in (empty: the language the user writes in); notes keep the language each command sets.
